# evinf

`evinf` fits **extreme-value inflated** count-regression models: the
extreme-value and zero-inflated negative binomial (EVZINB) model and its
zero-inflation-free counterpart (EVINB), as described in

> Randahl, David, and Johan Vegelius. 2024. “Inference with Extremes:
> Accounting for Extreme Values in Count Regression Models.”
> *International Studies Quarterly* 68(4): sqae137.
> <https://doi.org/10.1093/isq/sqae137>

The package also provides bootstrap-based inference, prediction
(component probabilities, harmonic mean, quantiles), likelihood-ratio
tests for individual covariates, and comparison against plain
negative-binomial and ZINB models. It is designed to work with `broom` /
`generics` ([`tidy()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/tidy.html),
[`glance()`](https://generics.r-lib.org/reference/glance.html)) and
`modelsummary`.

Since version 0.10.0 the EM tuning settings are bundled in
[`evinf_control()`](reference/evinf_control.md), the candidate range for
the extreme-value threshold `C_EV` is chosen from the data by default,
the count formula accepts an
[`offset()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/offset.html) term, and the fitted
models support the standard S3 methods
([`coef()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/coef.html),
[`vcov()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/vcov.html),
[`confint()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/confint.html),
[`AIC()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/AIC.html),
[`predict()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/predict.html),
[`residuals()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/residuals.html),
[`simulate()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/simulate.html),
[`update()`](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/update.html),
[`plot()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/plot.default.html)) as well as
[`predict_grid()`](reference/predict_grid.md),
[`marginal_effects()`](reference/marginal_effects.md) and
[`compare_fit()`](reference/compare_fit.md). See `NEWS.md` for the full
list.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("Doktorandahl/evinf")
```

## Usage

``` r

library(evinf)
data(genevzinb2)

# Fit an EVZINB model with 100 bootstrap replicates
model <- evzinb(y ~ x1 + x2 + x3, data = genevzinb2, n_bootstraps = 100)

summary(model)
tidy(model)                       # all components, one row per coefficient
glance(model)                     # goodness-of-fit
predict(model, type = "harmonic") # harmonic-mean prediction

lr_test(model, "x1")              # LR test for x1 across all components
compare_models(model)             # against NB and ZINB
```

Separate formulas can be given for the count, zero-inflation,
extreme-value inflation and Pareto components, e.g.

``` r

evzinb(y ~ x1 + x2, formula_zi = ~ x1, formula_pareto = ~ log1p(x3),
       data = genevzinb2)
```

# Package index

## Fitting

Estimate the EVZINB / EVINB model and tune the EM algorithm.

- [`evzinb()`](evzinb.md) : Running an extreme value and zero inflated
  negative binomial model with bootstrapping
- [`evinb()`](evinb.md) : Running an extreme value inflated negative
  binomial model with bootstrapping
- [`evinf_control()`](evinf_control.md) : Control settings for evzinb()
  / evinb()
- [`add_bootstraps()`](add_bootstraps.md) : Add more bootstrap
  replicates to a fitted model
- [`failed_bootstraps()`](failed_bootstraps.md) : Inspect the bootstrap
  replicates that failed or came out degenerate

## Summaries and tables

Inspect a fitted model and build regression tables.

- [`summary(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](summary.evzinb.md) : EVZINB summary
  function

- [`print(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](print.evzinb.md) : EVZINB print function

- [`tidy(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](tidy.evzinb.md) : EVZINB tidy function

- [`glance(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](glance.evzinb.md) : EVZINB and EVINB glance
  functions

- [`coefficient_extractor()`](coefficient_extractor.md) : Bootstrap
  coefficient extractor

- [`gof_map_evinf()`](gof_map_evinf.md) :

  Goodness-of-fit map for `modelsummary`

- [`gm_evzinb`](gm_evzinb.md) : A goodness-of-fit gof tibble for GOF
  metrics when using modelsummary

## Prediction and effects

Predicted quantities, prediction grids and marginal effects.

- [`predict(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](predict.evzinb.md) : Predictions from
  evzinb object
- [`predict_grid()`](predict_grid.md) : Build a prediction grid and
  evaluate a model over it
- [`marginal_effects()`](marginal_effects.md) : Average marginal effects
  for an evzinb / evinb model

## Diagnostics and plots

Threshold diagnostics, state classification and plot methods.

- [`plot(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](plot.evzinb.md)
  [`plot(`*`<evinb>`*`)`](plot.evzinb.md) : Plots for evzinb / evinb
  models
- [`c_profile()`](c_profile.md) : Log-likelihood profile over the
  candidate values of C_EV
- [`plot_c_profile()`](plot_c_profile.md) : Plot the log-likelihood
  profile over the candidate values of C_EV
- [`classify_states()`](classify_states.md) : Prior and posterior state
  classification
- [`state_table()`](state_table.md) : Cross-tabulate prior vs posterior
  state classification

## Model comparison

Compare against negative-binomial and ZINB alternatives.

- [`compare_models()`](compare_models.md) : Function to compare evzinb
  or evinb models with zinb and nb models
- [`compare_fit()`](compare_fit.md)
  [`plot(`*`<evzinbcomp>`*`)`](compare_fit.md) : Compare the
  extreme-value model against its plainer counterparts
- [`lr_test()`](lr_test.md) : Likelihood ratio test for individual
  variables of evzinb
- [`oob_evaluation()`](oob_evaluation.md) : Out of bag predictive
  performance of EVZINB and EVINB models
- [`tidy(`*`<evzinbcomp>`*`)`](evzinbcomp-tidiers.md)
  [`glance(`*`<evzinbcomp>`*`)`](evzinbcomp-tidiers.md) : Stacked tidy /
  glance for a model comparison

- [`update(`*`<evzinb>`*`)`](update.evzinb.md)
  [`update(`*`<evinb>`*`)`](update.evzinb.md) : Update and re-fit an

- [`reexports`](reexports.md) [`tidy`](reexports.md)
  [`glance`](reexports.md) : Objects exported from other packages

## Simulation

- [`revzinb_fit()`](revzinb_fit.md) : Random draws from a fitted evzinb
  model
- [`revinb_fit()`](revinb_fit.md) : Random draws from a fitted evinb
  model

## Data

- [`hks`](hks.md) : Replication data for Hultman, Kathman, and
  Shannon (2013) United Nations Peacekeeping and Civilian Protection in
  Civil War
- [`genevzinb`](genevzinb.md) : Simulated data from the EVZINB
  distribution
- [`genevzinb2`](genevzinb2.md) : Simulated data from the EVZINB
  distribution

## Estimation internals

The EM / ECME driver behind evzinb() and evinb(). Not exported;
documented for readers of the algorithm.

- [`em_fit()`](em_fit.md) : EM / ECME driver for the EVZINB and EVINB
  models
- [`em_fit_fixed_c()`](em_fit_fixed_c.md) : EM iterations for the EVZINB
  / EVINB mixture at a fixed \\C\_{EV}\\
- [`em_step()`](em_step.md) : One EM step for the EVZINB / EVINB mixture
  at fixed \\C\_{EV}\\
- [`em_profile_c()`](em_profile_c.md) : Profile the log-likelihood over
  the extreme-value threshold
- [`em_c_candidates()`](em_c_candidates.md) : Candidate set for the
  extreme-value threshold \\C\_{EV}\\
- [`em_extend_design()`](em_extend_design.md) : Prepend the intercept
  column to each component design matrix
- [`em_fitted_values()`](em_fitted_values.md) : Fitted quantities from a
  fitted EVZINB / EVINB parameter set
